clips.title: The story
paras: Fel'zerul is an orc warlock stationed at Stonard in the murky depths of the Swamp of Sorrows. Acting under direct orders from Warchief Thrall, he investigates the ominous presence lurking within the sunken Temple of Atal'Hakkar.

While Thrall's Horde generally views dark arts with suspicion, the Warchief recognizes that understanding sinister powers requires those who study them. Fel'zerul was dispatched to Stonard specifically to unravel the corruption surrounding the Pool of Tears and the submerged Temple of Atal'Hakkar. By directing adventurers to recover artifacts and investigate the exiled Atal'ai trolls, the warlock seeks to determine what evil stirs beneath the murky waters before it threatens the Horde's southern outpost.
